text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ready, set... "Resort Fest is the best~☆"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, inviting us to both a live show 
and a resort? Helios's aunt is way too 
generous.
choice_data_list: Was it really okay for me to come too?

Was it really okay for me to come along 
too?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! We already went on a trip with 
Yacchan together! You're definitely 
supposed to come!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! While maintaining moderation, we 
must enjoy ourselves to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So, when does that event stage with 
"Yacchan-san" start?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Early afternoon, right? EDM at a resort is 
pure hype――

text_block_list.name: Live Staff A
text_block_list.text: What did you say?! DJ UOO broke a bone?!

text_block_list.name: Live Staff B
text_block_list.text:
What should we do... Calling a replacement 
support DJ at this hour is completely 
impossible...

text_block_list.name: Live Staff A
text_block_list.text:
I feel terrible for Yacchan, but we have 
no choice but to play pre-recorded tracks 
without a DJ――

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hold up right there!! If you need a sub, 
I'll do it!!

text_block_list.name: Live Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yacchan's niece... We appreciate the 
thought, but an amateur keeping up with 
her is――

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I can do it! I've been listening to 
Yacchan's rap since I was little! Trained 
like crazy, so I can even keep up with her 
newest tracks!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The rapper, the DJ, and everyone together 
make the absolute beeeest live show, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If even one part is missing, it's not the 
absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Live Staff B
text_block_list.text:
...During rehearsals, Yacchan said 
something very similar.

text_block_list.name: Live Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go talk to Yacchan. But if 
she says no, you drop it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yacchan
text_block_list.text:
YO! YO! Sorry for the wait, pumpin' up the 
vibes! DJ leave it to her! Turn it up, 
Helios!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Helios? Who's that? Not DJ UOO...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
(Mm, vibes feel a little down? Guess 
they're guarded seeing someone 
new――buuut!)

text_block_list.name: Yacchan
text_block_list.text:
YO! YO! Goin' full throttle from the 
start, MEEN! ♯ [Sharp] drops the BEAT to 
START UP! HEART drops the BEAT to HEAT 
UP――

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Crazy good... Totally on another level 
compared to hearing it at a club.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But Helios-san is keeping up just fine. 
Actually, more than that――

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes, here it comes~!! My turn, 
boom-boom-BOOOOM☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
DJ Helios and Yacchan's~~~!! Explosive 
hype rap, get those vibes waaaay up---!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: FOOOOOO!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that DJ insane?! That solo just now 
gave me goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Right? And that's just the warm-up♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Believe and see it through, and a path 
will open――Helios! Show them even more of 
what you've got!!

text_block_list.name: Yacchan & Helios
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight!! Let's keep getting even 
more hyyyyped!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOAAAAHHH--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yacchan! Helios!! Yacchan! Helios!!

Since we weren't backstage today, I 
couldn't see Daitaku Helios's facial 
expression. But――

She was surely facing the turntable and 
the audience with that very same serious 
gaze as before. Amidst the wild cheering, 
I felt completely certain of it.
